locale.name: matomo.settings.useTokenForStatisticsDisplay.description
locale.en:
Note: In the Matomo instance, the LoginTokenAuth plugin must be enabled. In addition, the token must NOT come from a super-user of the Matomo instance.
If the token login is not to be used, Matomo credentials can be stored in the QUIQQER user profile instead.

locale.name: matomo.settings.trackToPaq
locale.en: Always push data layer to Matomo

locale.name: matomo.settings.trackToPaq.description
locale.en: The option 'Always push data layer to Matomo' causes all variables of the data layer to be automatically transferred to Matomo. This simplifies data analysis by seamlessly capturing user interactions and website information. However, if the Tag Manager is configured manually, it is recommended to deactivate this option, to avoid conflicts or data overlaps.

locale.name: matomo.settings.dataLayerBridge
locale.en: Forward data layer to Matomo Tag Manager

locale.name: matomo.settings.dataLayerBridge.description
locale.en: Forwards new entries from the QUIQQER data layer to Matomo Tag Manager. If the synchronisation status can be retrieved via the Matomo API, this setting is controlled automatically.

locale.name: matomo.settings.dataLayerBridge.automatic.syncEnabled
locale.en: Matomo synchronises the data layer automatically. The QUIQQER bridge is disabled.

locale.name: matomo.settings.dataLayerBridge.automatic.syncDisabled
locale.en: Matomo synchronisation is disabled. The QUIQQER bridge is enabled automatically.
